units.source_text: 匂亲王寻思：浮舟到底为了何事而突然死去，此事竟像做一个梦。

en.t: Prince Niou wondered why Ukifune had suddenly died, and the whole affair seemed like a dream.

units.source_text: 他心中怏怏不乐，便召唤时方等人，派他们到宇治去迎接右近。

en.t: His heart was heavy, so he summoned Tokikata and the others and sent them to Uji to bring Ukon back.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲住在宇治，听听宇治川的水声，自己也想跳进水里。

en.t: Ukifune's mother was staying in Uji, and when she heard the sound of the Uji River, she too wanted to throw herself into the water.

units.source_text: 悲伤忧愁无法消解，不胜其苦，便回京去了。

en.t: Unable to dispel her grief and sorrow, and unable to bear the pain, she returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 于是右近等只能和几个念佛的僧人做伴，非常寂寞无聊。

en.t: Thus Ukon and the others had only a few monks chanting the Buddha's name for company, and they felt terribly lonely and forlorn.

units.source_text: 正在此时，时方等人来了。

en.t: Just then, Tokikata and the others arrived.

units.source_text: 以前这里值宿人警备森严，但现在更无一人前来阻挡。

en.t: Formerly the night guards here had kept strict watch, but now not a single person came to stop them.

units.source_text: 时方回思前事，想道：“真遗憾啊！

en.t: Tokikata thought back on what had happened before and said to himself, How deeply regrettable.

units.source_text: 亲王最后一次来到这里时，竟被他们阻挡，不得入内。”

en.t: When the prince last came here, they actually stopped him and would not let him inside.

units.source_text: 便觉他很可怜。

en.t: Thinking this, he felt very sorry for him.

units.source_text: 他们在京中看见亲王为了这不足道的恋情而忧伤悲叹，觉得无聊之极。

en.t: In the capital, when they saw the prince grieving and lamenting over such an insignificant love affair, they had thought it utterly tiresome.

units.source_text: 但到了这里，回想起从前有好几夜不惮跋涉而来的情状，

en.t: But once they came here, they remembered how he had made the difficult journey many nights in the past without sparing himself.

units.source_text: 以及抱着浮舟乘舟时的光景，觉得其人丰姿何等优美。

en.t: They also remembered the scene of him holding Ukifune as they rode in the boat, and thought how graceful and beautiful he had looked.

units.source_text: 回思前事，大家垂头丧气，不胜感伤。

en.t: As they recalled the past, everyone hung their heads in dejection and was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 右近出来会见时方，一见就泣不可抑，这原是难怪她的。

en.t: When Ukon came out to meet Tokikata, she burst into uncontrollable tears at the sight of him, which was only natural.

units.source_text: 时方对她说：“匂亲王说如此如此，特地派我前来。”

en.t: Tokikata told her that Prince Niou had said such and such, and had especially sent him there.

units.source_text: 右近答道：“现在热丧之中，我就入京去见亲王，别人看了都将诧怪，我有所顾虑。

en.t: Ukon replied that if she went to the capital to see the prince while mourning was still so fresh, people would find it strange, and she was concerned about that.

units.source_text: 即使去见，也不能清清楚楚地报告，使亲王确悉详情。

en.t: Even if I saw him, I could not give a clear report and make the prince fully understand the details.

units.source_text: 且待四十九日丧忌过去之后，我找个借口，对人说‘我要出门一下’，这才像个样子。

en.t: It would be more proper to wait until the forty nine days of mourning have passed, then make some excuse and tell people that I am going out for a while.

units.source_text: 如果我能意外地苟延性命，则到了心情稍稍镇静之时，

en.t: If, unexpectedly, I manage to go on living until my feelings have calmed a little,

units.source_text: 即使亲王不召唤我，我也定当把这做梦一般的情状向亲王诉说。”

en.t: then even if the prince does not summon me, I will certainly tell him about these dreamlike circumstances.

units.source_text: 她今天不肯动身。

en.t: She refused to set out that day.

units.source_text: 时方大夫也哭起来，说道：“亲王和小姐的关系如何，我们并不详悉。

en.t: Tokikata no Taifu also began to weep and said that they did not know in detail what the relationship between the prince and the young lady had been.

units.source_text: 我们虽然是不知内情的人，但看见亲王对小姐宠爱无比，

en.t: Although we were people who did not know the inner circumstances, we saw how boundlessly the prince cherished the young lady,

units.source_text: 觉得不须急急地和你们亲近，将来自有替你们效劳的时候。

en.t: and we thought there was no need to hurry to become close to you, since there would surely be a time in the future when we could serve you.

units.source_text: 现在发生了这件不可挽回的悲惨之事，就我们的心境来说，更加希望同你们亲近了。”

en.t: Now that this irreversible tragedy has occurred, our own feelings make us wish all the more to be close to you.

units.source_text: 又说：“亲王思虑周至，特派车辆来接。

en.t: He also said that the prince had been very thoughtful and had specially sent a carriage to fetch her.

units.source_text: 如果空车回去，岂不使他失望？

en.t: If the carriage goes back empty, will that not disappoint him?

units.source_text: 既然如此，就请另一位侍从姐姐前往如何？”

en.t: In that case, how would it be if the other lady Jiju were to go instead?

units.source_text: 右近便呼唤侍从，对她说道：“那么你去走一遭吧。”

en.t: Ukon then called Jiju and said to her, Then please go in my place.

units.source_text: 侍从答道：“我更不会诉说情况。

en.t: Jiju replied, I am even less able to explain the circumstances.

units.source_text: 并且我丧服在身，亲王府中得不禁忌？”

en.t: Besides, I am wearing mourning clothes. Would that not be taboo in the prince's residence?

units.source_text: 时方说：“亲王患病，府中正在举办祈祷，原有种种禁忌，然而似乎并不禁忌服丧之人。

en.t: Tokikata said that the prince was ill and prayers were being held at his residence, so there were various taboos, but it seemed that mourners were not forbidden.

units.source_text: 况且亲王与小姐宿缘如此深厚，他自己也应服丧。

en.t: Moreover, since the karmic bond between the prince and the young lady was so deep, he himself ought to be in mourning as well.

units.source_text: 四十九日之期所剩已无多天，还请你今天劳驾吧。”

en.t: There are not many days left before the forty ninth day, so please trouble yourself to go today.

units.source_text: 侍从一向恋慕匂亲王的英姿。

en.t: Jiju had long admired Prince Niou's handsome figure.

units.source_text: 浮舟死后，她以为不得再见了。

en.t: After Ukifune's death, she had thought she would never see him again.

units.source_text: 今天乘此机会去见，私心乐愿，便动身入京。

en.t: Secretly pleased to have this chance to see him today, she set out for the capital.

units.source_text: 她身穿黑色丧服，打扮得很漂亮。

en.t: She wore black mourning clothes and had made herself look very beautiful.

units.source_text: 她现已没有主人，不必穿裳，所以没有把裳染成淡墨色。

en.t: Now that she had no mistress, she did not need to wear a formal skirt, so she had not dyed one pale ink gray.

units.source_text: 今天就把一条淡紫色的叫随从者带着，以便参见亲王时系上。

en.t: That day she brought along a pale purple cord called a zuiju, so that she could fasten it on when she met the prince.

units.source_text: 她设想如果小姐在世，她今天走这条路进京必须秘密。

en.t: She imagined that if her lady were still alive, this journey to the capital today would have had to be kept secret.

units.source_text: 她是私下同情匂亲王与浮舟的恋爱的。

en.t: In private, she had sympathized with the love between Prince Niou and Ukifune.

units.source_text: 她在路上不断地流泪，不久来到了匂亲王邸内。

en.t: She kept shedding tears along the road, and before long she arrived at Prince Niou's residence.
